Selected video work

Video Gallery

These projects were created for organisations including Mercator Ocean, ECMWF, ESA, EUMETSAT, and DLR. They combine editorial storytelling, motion design, and science communication to make complex environmental and space data more accessible.

Most entries below are embedded directly from YouTube, so you can watch them in place while scanning the title, date, client, and short description.

27

ESOcast 64: First Ring System Around Asteroid

ESO

Observations from South America, including ESO’s La Silla Observatory, revealed that the asteroid Chariklo is surrounded by two narrow rings, making it the smallest known object with rings and only the fifth body in the Solar System known to have this feature.

asteroid
↗View

28

ESOcast 65: The Chilean Sky in Ultra High Definition

ESO

In the Spring of 2014, a team of ESO Photo ambassadors embarked on a pioneering expedition to ESO's three observatories in Chile. Their mission was to capture a wide range of images and timelapses of the magnificent Chilean night sky and landscape in crisp Ultra High Definition. Join our heroes in their adventures in the arid Atacama Desert as they bring our Universe closer than ever before.

chile
↗View

29

ESOcast 66: A Groundbreaking Event for the E-ELT

ESO

On 19 June 2014, a major milestone on the road to the construction of the European Extremely Large Telescope was reached. Part of the 3000-metre peak of Cerro Armazones was blasted away as a step towards levelling the summit. This paves the way for the largest optical/infrared telescope in the world.

E-ELT
